title: EPIC: Efficient Position-Independent Caching for Serving Large Language Models
authors: Junhao Hu; Wenrui Huang; Weidong Wang; Haoyi Wang; Tiancheng Hu; Qin Zhang; Hao Feng; Xusheng Chen; Yizhou Shan; Tao Xie
affiliations: Peking University, Nanjing University, Huawei Cloud
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Existing context caching requires exact prefix matches to reuse KV vectors, so immutable chunks (documents, few-shot examples) that are preceded by varying prefixes cannot be reused — limiting reuse in RAG and few-shot settings. Naively concatenating independently-cached chunk KV in a position-independent way degrades accuracy because it violates the standard attention mechanism.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 context caching 需要精確的 prefix 比對才能重用 KV 向量,因此被不同 prefix 前綴的 immutable chunk(文件、few-shot 範例)無法被重用,限制了 RAG 與 few-shot 情境下的重用機會。若直接以 position-independent 方式拼接各自獨立 cache 的 chunk KV,則會因違反標準 attention 機制而損失準確率。

key_innovation.en: Formalizes Position-Independent Caching (PIC) as a compile–link framework: chunks are 'compiled' into independent KV caches with positions starting from zero, then 'linked' at query time. Its LegoLink algorithm recomputes only the first k (k <= 32) tokens of each non-initial chunk — selected by STATIC attention sparsity — to correct the 'attention sink' at chunk boundaries, reducing link cost to O(kN) ~ O(N) instead of CacheBlend's O(15%·N^2).
key_innovation.zh: 將 Position-Independent Caching (PIC) 形式化為 compile–link 框架:chunk 先以位置從零開始『編譯』成獨立 KV cache,再於查詢時『連結』。其 LegoLink 演算法僅重算每個非首個 chunk 的前 k 個(k <= 32)token —— 依 static attention sparsity 預先選定 —— 以修正 chunk 邊界的『attention sink』效應,使連結成本降為 O(kN) ~ O(N),取代 CacheBlend 的 O(15%·N^2)。

baselines_compared: CacheBlend, Full KV Reuse, Full Recompute

key_improvements.en: Up to 8x TTFT reduction and 7x throughput gain over existing systems under multi-request, varying-rate (asynchronous) workloads, with negligible or no accuracy loss. Against CacheBlend specifically: up to 3x TTFT improvement with accuracy loss within 7%; the near-linear O(kN) recompute avoids OOM (CacheBlend-15 hits OOM at ~35k tokens, whereas LegoLink-16 scales to ~50k).
key_improvements.zh: 在多請求、變動速率(asynchronous)工作負載下,相較既有系統 TTFT 最高降低 8x、吞吐量提升 7x,且準確率幾乎無損。相較 CacheBlend:TTFT 最高改善 3x、準確率損失控制在 7% 以內;近線性的 O(kN) 重算可避免 OOM(CacheBlend-15 約在 35k tokens 即 OOM,而 LegoLink-16 可擴展至約 50k)。
